title: More Tools N' Stuff
description: MTNS adds in brand new biomes, blocks, items and more into Minecraft!
body:
## Embark on an adventure to the Moon and Mars and discover brand-new biomes, blocks, items, and more!

### **1. New Ores!** 
> - Nether, 
> - End
> - and Real-Life/Custom variants!

### **2. New biomes!**
> - Forests, 
> - Jungles,
> - Cave biomes
> - And more!

### **3. A bunch of new blocks!**
> - Custom made variants of existing blocks!
> - A bunch of new custom blocks!
> - And even some classics!

### **4. Brand new tools, weapons and armor (+ items and food)!**
> - Ranging from custom to joke items!
> - And even some Vanilla-like ones!

### **5. Brand new dimensions!**
> - The Moon and its various features,
> - And Mars with its own various features too!

### **6. Additionally..**
> - Want to see the old textures of some MTNS blocks? Use the Classic Textures resourcepack (compatible with MTNS 2.10+)



**_This mod has been made in MCreator. (Link: https://mcreator.net/)_**

***Notice: There may be a slow update cycle between versions - please be patient!
